task: 【示意案例】围绕研究问题『神经形态计算的器件与架构在 2016-2026 年经历了怎样的主题演化，热点在哪、空白在哪』完成趋势分析。本案例为合成示例，标题/摘要/年份/引用数均为虚构，仅用于演示 Skill 的完整使用流程，不是正式测试案例。

records.title: Memristor crossbar arrays for neuromorphic devices
records.abstract: This early work demonstrated dense memristor crossbar arrays and characterized their switching variability across 1000 cycles.

records.title: Oxygen vacancy engineering in memristor stacks
records.abstract: We engineered oxygen vacancy profiles to stabilize resistive switching in memristor stacks.

records.title: 阻变器件良率与氧空位通道分布的关系
records.abstract: 系统统计了氧空位通道分布对阻变器件良率的影响，并提出通道密度控制工艺。

records.title: Memristor endurance under pulsed operation
records.abstract: Pulsed operation degrades memristor endurance; we quantify failure modes under 10^9 pulses.

records.title: Memristor variability in scaled crossbar arrays
records.abstract: In scaled crossbar arrays, memristor variability dominates system-level accuracy loss; we provide a device-to-array variability model.

records.title: Endurance modeling of memristor devices beyond 10^10 cycles
records.abstract: We model memristor endurance beyond 10^10 cycles with a vacancy diffusion framework.

records.title: Surrogate gradient learning in spiking neural networks
records.abstract: This work enabled gradient-based training of spiking neural networks with surrogate gradients, replacing non-differentiable spikes with smooth surrogates.

records.title: Temporal coding with spiking neurons
records.abstract: We showed temporal coding with spiking neurons improves latency-accuracy trade-offs on small benchmarks.

records.title: Spiking networks for event-based vision
records.abstract: Event-based cameras paired with spiking networks cut energy use in edge vision pipelines.

records.title: 基于脉冲神经网络的时序语音识别
records.abstract: 将脉冲神经网络用于时序语音识别，在低功耗端侧场景验证了可行性。

records.title: Spiking transformers with spike-aware attention
records.abstract: We reformulate attention as spike-aware computation, extending spiking models to transformer-scale tasks.

records.title: Local learning rules for deep spiking models
records.abstract: Deep spiking models trained with local learning rules remove full backpropagation while matching gradient baselines on vision tasks.

records.title: Spiking foundation models for edge vision
records.abstract: We scale spiking foundation models to billion-parameter regimes and report energy-accuracy frontiers.

records.title: In-memory compute primitives for convolutional accelerators
records.abstract: We proposed in-memory compute primitives that keep convolution weights on-chip, avoiding off-chip weight traffic.

records.title: 存内计算阵列的精度-能耗联合设计
records.abstract: 提出存内计算阵列的精度-能耗联合设计方法，在低精度任务上实现能效提升。

records.title: In-memory compute for sparse linear algebra
records.abstract: We map sparse linear algebra kernels onto in-memory compute arrays with bit-serial precision.

records.title: Analog in-memory acceleration for transformer inference
records.abstract: Analog in-memory acceleration of transformer inference reaches two orders of magnitude energy savings at iso-accuracy.

records.title: 存内计算用于推荐系统检索粗排
records.abstract: 在检索粗排场景评估存内计算的召回-能耗折中，并给出工程部署约束。
